subject: general
question: Which Indian state won the most number of medals at the Khelo India Youth Games 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra **won the most number of medals at the Khelo India Youth Games 2020.

 
• ​The second edition of Khelo India Youth Games was held in Pune.
 
• Maharashtra topped the Medal tally with 228 medals, whereas Haryana and Delhi claimed the second and third spot.
 
• Maharashtra bagged 'General Championship of Khelo India 2019' with 85 Gold Medals.
 
• Students from colleges and universities competed in the games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 1st edition of Khelo India games was held in Delhi in January 2018.
 
• The Khelo India games are organised by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports.
 
• 3rd edition of the Khelo India Youth Games will be held at Guwahati from January 18-30, 2020. 
 
• The Games will see a participation of more than 10,000 athletes and officials. It will be conducted in partnership with IOA, SGFI, and Assam as a host state.
